低音的問題在這個編制裡相對解決得比較好：巴拉萊卡倍低音確實存在，音域夠低。但它是: The bass problem is solved relatively well in this line-up: the contrabass balalaika really exists, and its range is low enough. But it is plucked, so it decays fast and cannot hold a long note the way a double bass does with the bow, which is why the bass line often sounds like a row of dots rather than a line. The orchestra's remedy is to double it with the bayan or the bass domra, or to cover the gap with density in the percussion and the harmony. This is also why a Russian folk orchestra's bass sounds granular, one bead at a time, rather than the continuous low end of a symphony orchestra.

俄羅斯民族樂團（Russian Folk Orchestra）— 以巴拉萊卡與多: Russian Folk Orchestra — a Russian plucked-string ensemble built on the balalaika and domra families and supported by state institutions. Ensembles and instrumentation by Next Door Sound Weavers.
俄羅斯民族樂團（оркестр русских народных инструм: The Russian folk orchestra (оркестр русских народных инструментов) is a large ensemble built around two families of plucked strings, the balalaika and the domra, with the bayan (button accordion), the gusli, wind instruments and percussion added. Its range, from the top down to the contrabass, is covered entirely by one family of instruments, which is rare among national ensembles; the price is that the whole orchestra's sound rests on the single action of plucking. Today's professional orchestras mostly belong to state concert halls, broadcasters and regional cultural institutions.

兩者的琴身、調弦與奏法都不同：多姆拉圓背、用撥片、四度或五度調弦；巴拉萊卡三角琴: The two have different bodies, tunings and playing methods: the domra has a round back, is played with a pick and is tuned in fourths or fifths; the balalaika has a triangular body, alternates fingers and pick, and has two strings in unison plus a third. In the orchestra they belong to different sections.

The Chinese orchestra builds its own gehu for the bass, or simply switches to cellos and double basses; in the Russian orchestra the bass is handled by the balalaika family itself. Both use twelve-tone equal temperament, but the Russian orchestra tunes to the fixed pitch of the bayan, while the Chinese orchestra tunes to the sheng and the yangqin.

多姆拉的家族通常是高音、中音、低音（有些團加上倍低音），三弦多姆拉以四度調弦，四: The domra family is usually soprano, alto and bass (some orchestras add a contrabass); the three-string domra is tuned in fourths, the four-string domra in fifths, and the two exist side by side, with different orchestras choosing by tradition. The balalaika comes in five sizes — prima, second, alto, bass and contrabass — with the prima and second three-string, two strings in unison plus a third, and every size from the alto down scaled up in turn. This family lets the orchestra lay out four-part harmony without borrowing cellos, and that is the biggest difference between it and the Chinese and Korean orchestras.
多姆拉與巴拉萊卡是同一種樂器的不同叫法。: The domra and the balalaika are two names for the same instrument.
巴拉萊卡只是一種民俗樂器，不能演奏嚴肅的音樂。: The balalaika is just a folk instrument and cannot play serious music.
巴拉萊卡家族包含高音到倍低音五種尺寸，職業民族樂團用它演奏交響改編、協奏曲與原創: The balalaika family runs from prima to contrabass in five sizes, and professional folk orchestras use it to play symphonic arrangements, concertos and original works. Its limit is not that it is unserious, but the decay of a plucked string and the acoustics of a triangular body.
巴拉萊卡的琴身是三角形。這個形狀不只是辨識標誌，它直接限制了樂器的聲學條件：面板: The balalaika's body is triangular. The shape is not just a badge of identity; it directly fixes the instrument's acoustic conditions: a small top area, a shallow cavity, and straight edges that make the top vibrate differently from a round or gourd-shaped body, so the sound is drier, shorter, concentrated in projection but not thick. The only way to get more volume is to enlarge the body; and as a triangle is scaled up, its weight grows faster than its top area, so the contrabass balalaika ends up a huge triangle that has to be played standing on the floor or on a stand. This is why the balalaika family's bass, though it exists, is still limited in volume and thickness. The domra has a round-backed, hemispherical body; it resonates more fully than the balalaika, but the depth of its body also limits its bass.

撥片的起音是第二個核心問題。多姆拉用撥片，巴拉萊卡用指甲與撥片交替，兩種起音的時: The attack of the pick is the second core problem. The domra uses a pick, the balalaika alternates fingernail and pick, and the two kinds of attack have a different sense of time; for a large ensemble to be together, the depth, angle and string-crossing time of the pick have to be unified, or the same chord will sound like a string of points out of step. The traditional Russian method is to join the points into a line with fast perpetual-motion picking (tremolo-style), while using strongly marked attacks to sharpen the rhythm. This aesthetic of the pick instead of the bow is the foundation of the whole orchestra's sound.
整個樂團沒有弓。交響樂團靠弦樂維持長音，這裡只能靠三種替代：巴揚的持續和弦、多姆: The whole orchestra has no bow. A symphony orchestra sustains long notes with its strings; here there are only three substitutes: the bayan's sustained chords, the domra's fast tremolo, and the natural reverberation of plucked notes. The bayan is therefore not just an accompanist but the orchestra's breathing — it holds the harmony when the harmony needs to continue, and it is the reference when the intonation needs checking. That brings a structural dependence with it: if the bayan is missing, the whole orchestra's long notes and harmony collapse.
曲目大致分四類：俄羅斯與其他民族的民歌、舞曲改編（圓舞曲、卡林卡式的快舞曲）、古: The repertoire falls roughly into four kinds: the folk songs of Russia and other peoples; dance arrangements (waltzes, fast Kalinka-style dances); arrangements of classical symphonic works and operas; and concertos and original orchestral works written for balalaika, domra and bayan. Folk-song arrangements usually keep the lead singer and the chorus, with the orchestra accompanying and playing interludes; classical arrangements move whole string sections onto the plucked family, so continuous phrases once drawn out with the bow are broken into individual plucked notes, and the arranger has to redistribute the tremolo so the melody does not collapse in slow passages.
最接近的是曼陀林樂團。兩者都以撥弦為主體，用快速的輪撥代替弓來維持長音，也都在低: The nearest is the mandolin orchestra. Both are built on plucked strings, both use fast tremolo instead of the bow to sustain notes, and both run into decay that is too fast in the bass. The difference is the family and who owns the bass: the mandolin orchestra is laid out by the string orchestra's ranges, first and second mandolins in G–D–A–E, mandola and mandocello stepping down (C–G–D–A), and the true contrabass still borrowed from the double bass; in the Russian folk orchestra the domra and balalaika form their own family, and the contrabass balalaika really exists — it is just plucked, so the bass comes one bead at a time rather than in a line. The source of sustained harmony differs too: the Russian orchestra has the bayan, the mandolin orchestra has no equivalent instrument.
職業團是國家機構的一部分，曲目包含古典改編與大型原創作品，演出場合是音樂廳與慶典: Professional orchestras are part of state institutions, their repertoire includes classical arrangements and large original works, and they perform in concert halls and at celebrations. Folk song is only one part of their repertoire.
職業團的舞台是音樂廳、廣播電視、節慶與國家慶典；地方則有文化館、學校與業餘團。這: The professional orchestra's stage is the concert hall, broadcasting, festivals and state celebrations; locally there are cultural centres, schools and amateur groups. In the twentieth century this line-up was absorbed into state cultural institutions and became the representative of national art, so its repertoire was long tied to state celebrations, patriotic songs, folk dances and classical arrangements. Today's professional orchestras are still set up by city, region or broadcasting system, usually with a place name or institution in their title; local cultural centres and schools keep amateur balalaika groups, domra groups and folk-instrument classes, much smaller than the professional orchestras and closer to folk songs and dances.

與管弦樂團相比，差別在發聲方式。管弦樂團的低音由弓持續供給能量，俄羅斯團整個樂團: Compared with a symphony orchestra, the difference is how the sound is produced. In a symphony orchestra the bass is fed energy continuously by the bow; in a Russian orchestra the whole ensemble is built on the single action of plucking, so slow phrases in symphonic arrangements have to be rewritten as a density of tremolo.

這個編制的核心原則是：用同一族撥弦樂器的不同尺寸，覆蓋整個音域。多姆拉與巴拉萊卡: The core principle of this line-up is: cover the whole range with different sizes of one family of plucked instruments. The domra and the balalaika are each built as a family, then arranged by the section positions of a symphony orchestra.
音律上，這個編制採十二平均律，巴揚是固定的平均律樂器，多姆拉與巴拉萊卡向它靠攏。: In tuning, the line-up uses twelve-tone equal temperament; the bayan is a fixed equal-tempered instrument and the domra and balalaika tune towards it. But Russian folk singing and some wind instruments (the zhaleika, for instance) originally had slides, microtones and free ornament, and in ensemble these are tidied into written ornaments. What is gained is the ability to play symphonies, concertos, opera excerpts and large original works; what is lost is the regional differences in tuning, the improvised ornament, and the individual timbre of each village's instruments.
